entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to make a return. I bought a VeloBand Cadence Sensor and it's just not working for me.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF88712.
Thank you, Alex. I have your order right here. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a fault. The pulse reading is completely inaccurate. I compared it to my chest strap, and this band is basically garbage. It's off by 30 or 40 beats per minute sometimes.

I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the pulse accuracy. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. We can try a quick firmware reset, which often resolves calibration issues. Do you have the VeloBand nearby?
Look, I appreciate the offer, but I don't have time to play tech support. The product should work out of the box. I just want my money back, a full refund.
I understand your frustration and that you'd prefer a direct return. Let me just check the return eligibility on your order. One moment.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I see here that the item was delivered 27 days ago, on December 15th.
Let's see... looking at our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So, you are well within the window for a return.
Oh, perfect. I was worried I might have missed the deadline. So, a full refund is possible then?

Yes, absolutely. I'm processing that for you right now. I've just emailed a prepaid return label to the address on file. Please package the VeloBand in its original box, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll issue the refund to your original payment method.
That's great. Much easier than I expected. Thank you for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
